segments.motivation: To efficiently organize, track, and manage project tasks and team collaboration, ensuring deadlines are met and progress is clear.
To streamline personal and business workflows, manage diverse tasks, and keep track of all responsibilities and ideas in a visual way.

segments.role_family: Cross-functional Team Members (e.g., Marketing, Software Dev)
segments.motivation: To collaborate visually on tasks, share information, and manage deadlines within specific departmental projects, improving transparency and communication.

tasks.object: personal and team to-dos and ideas
tasks.purpose: to stay on top of responsibilities and goals
by adding due dates, attachments, and checklists for comprehensive oversight
to streamline processes and allow focus on more critical tasks
to simplify workflows and centralize communication and data
to brainstorm new ideas and condense lengthy texts instantly

benefits.claim: Provides a clear, visual, and intuitive way to organize and track tasks and projects, enhancing overall clarity.
Improves efficiency by centralizing all task-related information, including due dates and attachments, in one accessible place.
Streamlines workflows and boosts productivity through automation capabilities and seamless integrations with essential business tools.

frictions.claim: The board-and-card visual structure may not be suitable for all complex project management methodologies or advanced reporting needs.
For very large teams or highly intricate projects, the tool might feel less comprehensive or become cluttered, requiring significant effort to maintain organization.
While generally easy to use, utilizing advanced features like custom fields or setting up complex automations might require an initial learning investment.
